limitations: Live approval authenticity/provisioning and credential-isolated egress are not implemented; disabled entry point is not an enforcement proof.
Ordinary gateway retains default fetch; an operator outside the approved workflow could supply a credential.
Local filesystem controls do not protect against a privileged operator replacing code or stores; no external spending cap.
Physical disk fsync failure/power loss not injected; actual SQLite deferred-constraint COMMIT failure was tested.
New workflow checks outbox then manually invokes processor/queues; not an independent proof of AiRuntime polling.
Provider provenance label remains unverified; no live generation records retrieved.
